event._eventPart: Para Inclusive One Person Technical Keelboat (2.4mR) - Inclusive
event._name: Para Inclusive One Person Technical Keelboat (2.4mR) - Inclusive

sailors.biography: I've been sailing since I was six. Have sailed in several open boats such as the Mirror Dingy, 420, 470, Contender and the RS600. In addition, I participated in the IMS circuit with various sailing yachts in both inshore and offshore races. After a car accident in 2014 I was forced to stop sailing due to an incomplete spinal cord injury. Eight years after the accident I came into contact with the 2.4mR class. I bought the boat at random and since then I have a big smile on my face because I can sail again without putting a lot of strain on my body.
sailors.name: Pieter Visser
